attributes.title: [Logs OpenShift] Overview
attributes.description: Application and infrastructure logs forwarded by the OpenShift Logging collector: log volume, levels, namespaces, nodes, pods with errors, and node journald units.

params.markdown:
## [Logs OpenShift] Overview

Logs of OpenShift workloads (`openshift.application`) and of the platform namespaces and nodes
(`openshift.infrastructure`), forwarded by the OpenShift Logging collector.

Audit events are on the **Audit** dashboard.

query.esql:
FROM logs-openshift.application-*
| STATS application_logs = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.application-*
| STATS application_logs = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| STATS infrastructure_logs = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| STATS infrastructure_logs = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| WHERE log.level IN ("error", "err", "fatal", "critical", "crit", "alert", "emergency", "emerg")
| STATS error_logs = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| WHERE log.level IN ("error", "err", "fatal", "critical", "crit", "alert", "emergency", "emerg")
| STATS error_logs = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| WHERE kubernetes.namespace IS NOT NULL
| STATS namespaces = COUNT_DISTINCT(kubernetes.namespace)

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| WHERE kubernetes.namespace IS NOT NULL
| STATS namespaces = COUNT_DISTINCT(kubernetes.namespace)

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| EVAL source = CONCAT(openshift.log_type, " / ", openshift.log_source)
| STATS logs = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), source
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| EVAL source = CONCAT(openshift.log_type, " / ", openshift.log_source)
| STATS logs = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), source
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| WHERE kubernetes.namespace IS NOT NULL
| STATS logs = COUNT(*) BY kubernetes.namespace, openshift.log_type
| SORT logs DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| WHERE kubernetes.namespace IS NOT NULL
| STATS logs = COUNT(*) BY kubernetes.namespace, openshift.log_type
| SORT logs DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| EVAL level = COALESCE(log.level, "unknown")
| STATS logs = COUNT(*) BY level, openshift.log_type
| SORT logs DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| EVAL level = COALESCE(log.level, "unknown")
| STATS logs = COUNT(*) BY level, openshift.log_type
| SORT logs DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| STATS logs = COUNT(*) BY host.name, openshift.log_source
| SORT logs DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| STATS logs = COUNT(*) BY host.name, openshift.log_source
| SORT logs DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| WHERE kubernetes.pod.name IS NOT NULL
| WHERE log.level IN ("error", "err", "fatal", "critical", "crit", "alert", "emergency", "emerg")
| STATS errors = COUNT(*) BY kubernetes.namespace, kubernetes.pod.name, kubernetes.container.name
| SORT errors DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.application-*, logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| WHERE kubernetes.pod.name IS NOT NULL
| WHERE log.level IN ("error", "err", "fatal", "critical", "crit", "alert", "emergency", "emerg")
| STATS errors = COUNT(*) BY kubernetes.namespace, kubernetes.pod.name, kubernetes.container.name
| SORT errors DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "node"
| EVAL unit = COALESCE(systemd.unit, log.syslog.appname, "unknown")
| STATS logs = COUNT(*) BY unit
| SORT logs DESC
| LIMIT 15

FROM logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "node"
| EVAL unit = COALESCE(systemd.unit, log.syslog.appname, "unknown")
| STATS logs = COUNT(*) BY unit
| SORT logs DESC
| LIMIT 15

FROM logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "node"
| WHERE log.level IN ("error", "err", "crit", "critical", "alert", "emerg", "emergency", "warning", "warn")
| STATS logs = COUNT(*) BY host.name, systemd.unit, log.level
| SORT logs DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.infrastructure-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "node"
| WHERE log.level IN ("error", "err", "crit", "critical", "alert", "emerg", "emergency", "warning", "warn")
| STATS logs = COUNT(*) BY host.name, systemd.unit, log.level
| SORT logs DESC
| LIMIT 20
